raw_segments.text: It is indeed easy to discover different interests in the different parts of the Union, but I
am unacquainted with any which are hostile to each other.
The southern states are almost exclusively agricultural.
The northern states are more peculiarly commercial in manufacturing.
The states of the west are at the same time agricultural and manufacturing.
In the south the crops consist of tobacco, of rice, of cotton, and of sugar.
In the north and the west, of wheat and maize.
These are different sources of wealth.
But Union is the means by which these sources are open to all and rendered equally advantageous
